welcome_page.title: Welcome to Safety and Environment
welcome_page.description:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire focuses on perceived safety, security and environmental conditions during your journeys. Your answers help us understand which street and urban factors influence comfort, risk and accessibility. Participation is voluntary and anonymous.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

sections.title: Safety Perception
sections.description: Questions about how safe and secure you feel during your typical journey (the trip you most commonly make in your daily life, such as travelling to work, university, school, shopping, or other regular activities). These questions refer both to safety (protection from accidents or physical harm) and security (protection from crime, harassment, or feeling unsafe).

questions.text: How secure do you feel on your typical journey in relation to crime or harassment?

options.text: Not at all secure
Slightly secure
Moderately secure
Very secure
Completely secure

questions.text: What factors most reduce your sense of security?

options.text: Poor lighting (e.g., dark streets, underpasses)
Lack of people around (isolated or deserted areas)
Presence of suspicious or aggressive individuals
Overcrowding or chaotic environments
Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, obstructed views)
Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned buildings, graffiti, broken infrastructure)
Lack of surveillance or security measures (e.g., no cameras, no staff)
Previous personal or reported incidents in the area
I don't feel insecure at all
Other

questions.text: How safe (e.g. accidents, road conditions) do you consider your typical travel environment to be?

options.text: Not safe at all
Slightly safe
Moderately safe
Very safe
Completely safe

questions.text: Which of the following situations on a trip do you consider unsafe?

options.text: Heavy or fast-moving traffic
Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure (e.g. sidewalks, crossings, cycle paths, lighting)
Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. potholes, debris, uneven surfaces)
Poor visibility or limited sightlines
Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, or pedestrians
Crowding or conflicts with other road users
Absence of emergency services
I don't feel unsafe at all
Other

sections.title: Environmental Factors
sections.description: Questions about how your surroundings affect your travel experience.

questions.text: Thinking about your typical journey, to what extent does noise from traffic bother or annoy you?

options.text: Not at all
Slightly
Moderately
Very
Extremely

questions.text: How do air quality and pollution levels (e.g. exhaust fumes, dust, or unpleasant odours) affect your journey?

options.text: No effect at all
I notice it but it doesn't change my behaviour
It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. mask, closed windows)
It makes me change my route or travel at a different time
It makes me switch to a different mode of transport entirely

questions.text: If the weather is poor (e.g., rain, wind, cold, extreme heat or humidity), how does it affect your typical journey?

options.text: No effect at all
It makes my journey less comfortable, but I do not change how I travel
It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g., clothing, preparation, or route)
It makes me postpone or avoid some trips when possible
It makes me switch to a different mode of transport

questions.text: How do the cleanliness and maintenance of paths and facilities (e.g. litter, smells, or broken glass) affect your journey?

options.text: No effect on how I travel
I notice it but carry on as usual
It makes the journey unpleasant but I still use the route
It makes me avoid certain stops or sections of the route
It puts me off using this route entirely

questions.text: How much does the visual quality of your surroundings (e.g., architecture, public spaces, or overall atmosphere) influence your travel experience?

options.text: Not at all, I do not pay attention to the visual environment
Slightly, I notice the surroundings, but they rarely affect my experience
Moderately, pleasant or unpleasant surroundings sometimes affect my mood during travel
Strongly, the visual environment significantly affects my travel experience
Very strongly, I sometimes choose routes because they are visually appealing or interesting

it.#Welcome to Safety and Environment: Benvenuto/a nel questionario sulla sicurezza e l'ambiente
it.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Questo questionario SmartUrbanity si concentra sulla percezione della sicurezza personale e stradale e sulle condizioni ambientali durante i tuoi spostamenti. Le tue risposte ci aiutano a comprendere quali caratteristiche delle strade e dell'ambiente urbano influenzano il comfort, il rischio e l'accessibilità. La partecipazione è volontaria e anonima.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#<p>Questions about how safe and secure: Domande su quanto ti senti al sicuro e protetto/a durante il tuo spostamento abituale (lo spostamento che effettui più frequentemente nella vita quotidiana, ad esempio per andare al lavoro, all'università, a scuola, a fare acquisti o per altre attività regolari). Queste domande riguardano sia la sicurezza stradale (protezione da incidenti o danni fisici) sia la sicurezza personale (protezione da criminalità, molestie o situazioni percepite come pericolose).
it.#How secure do you feel on your typical: Quanto ti senti protetto/a da criminalità o molestie durante il tuo spostamento abituale?
it.#What factors most reduce your sense of: Quali fattori riducono maggiormente la tua percezione di sicurezza personale?
it.#Poor lighting (e.g., dark streets, unde: Scarsa illuminazione (ad es. strade buie, sottopassaggi)
it.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: Assenza di persone nelle vicinanze (zone isolate o deserte)
it.#Presence of suspicious or aggressive in: Presenza di persone sospette o aggressive
it.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: Scarsa visibilità (ad es. angoli ciechi, visuale ostruita)
it.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: Scarsa manutenzione (ad es. edifici abbandonati, graffiti, infrastrutture danneggiate)
it.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: Mancanza di sorveglianza o misure di sicurezza (ad es. assenza di telecamere o personale)
it.#Previous personal or reported incidents: Precedenti episodi personali o segnalati nella zona
it.#How safe (e.g. accidents, road conditio: Quanto consideri sicuro il tuo ambiente di viaggio abituale rispetto a incidenti e condizioni stradali?
it.#Which of the following situations on a: Quali delle seguenti situazioni durante uno spostamento consideri pericolose?
it.#Heavy or fast-moving traffic: Traffico intenso o ad alta velocità
it.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Mancanza di infrastrutture sicure o adeguate (ad es. marciapiedi, attraversamenti, piste ciclabili, illuminazione)
it.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Cattive condizioni della strada o dei percorsi (ad es. buche, detriti, superfici irregolari)
it.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Comportamenti pericolosi di automobilisti, conducenti di altri veicoli o pedoni
it.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: Affollamento o conflitti con altri utenti della strada
it.#I don't feel unsafe at all: Non mi sento affatto in pericolo
it.#<p>Questions about how your surrounding: Domande su come l'ambiente circostante influisce sulla tua esperienza di viaggio.
it.#Thinking about your typical journey, to: Pensando al tuo spostamento abituale, in che misura il rumore del traffico ti disturba o ti infastidisce?
it.#How do air quality and pollution levels: In che modo la qualità dell'aria e i livelli di inquinamento (ad es. gas di scarico, polvere o odori sgradevoli) influiscono sul tuo spostamento?
it.#I notice it but it doesn't change my be: Me ne accorgo, ma non modifica il mio comportamento
it.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. m: Mi porta a modificare il modo in cui viaggio (ad es. usando una mascherina o tenendo i finestrini chiusi)
it.#It makes me change my route or travel a: Mi porta a cambiare percorso o a viaggiare in un orario diverso
it.#It makes me switch to a different mode: Mi porta a scegliere una modalità di trasporto completamente diversa
it.#If the weather is poor (e.g., rain, win: In caso di condizioni meteorologiche sfavorevoli (ad es. pioggia, vento, freddo, caldo estremo o umidità), in che modo viene influenzato il tuo spostamento abituale?
it.#It makes my journey less comfortable, b: Rende il mio spostamento meno confortevole, ma non cambio il modo in cui viaggio
it.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g.,: Mi porta a modificare il modo in cui viaggio (ad es. abbigliamento, preparazione o percorso)
it.#It makes me postpone or avoid some trip: Mi porta a rimandare o evitare alcuni spostamenti quando possibile
it.#It makes me switch to a different mode: Mi porta a scegliere una modalità di trasporto diversa
it.#How do the cleanliness and maintenance: In che modo la pulizia e la manutenzione dei percorsi e delle strutture (ad es. rifiuti, cattivi odori o vetri rotti) influiscono sul tuo spostamento?
it.#No effect on how I travel: Nessun effetto sul modo in cui viaggio
it.#I notice it but carry on as usual: Me ne accorgo, ma continuo come al solito
it.#It makes the journey unpleasant but I s: Rende lo spostamento spiacevole, ma continuo a utilizzare il percorso
it.#It makes me avoid certain stops or sect: Mi porta a evitare determinate fermate o tratti del percorso
it.#It puts me off using this route entirel: Mi scoraggia completamente dall'utilizzare questo percorso
it.#How much does the visual quality of you: Quanto influisce la qualità visiva dell'ambiente circostante (ad es. architettura, spazi pubblici o atmosfera generale) sulla tua esperienza di viaggio?
it.#Not at all, I do not pay attention to t: Per niente, non presto attenzione all'ambiente visivo
it.#Slightly, I notice the surroundings, bu: Poco, noto l'ambiente circostante, ma raramente influisce sulla mia esperienza
it.#Moderately, pleasant or unpleasant surr: Moderatamente, un ambiente piacevole o sgradevole a volte influisce sul mio umore durante lo spostamento
it.#Strongly, the visual environment signif: Molto, l'ambiente visivo influisce significativamente sulla mia esperienza di viaggio
it.#Very strongly, I sometimes choose route: Moltissimo, a volte scelgo determinati percorsi perché sono visivamente piacevoli o interessanti

fr.#Welcome to Safety and Environment: Bienvenue dans le questionnaire sur la sécurité et l’environnement
fr.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Ce questionnaire SmartUrbanity porte sur votre perception de la sécurité routière, de la sécurité personnelle et des conditions environnementales pendant vos déplacements. Vos réponses nous aident à comprendre quels éléments des rues et de l’environnement urbain influencent le confort, le risque et l’accessibilité. La participation est volontaire et anonyme.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#<p>Questions about how safe and secure: Les questions suivantes concernent votre sentiment de sécurité pendant votre trajet habituel, c’est-à-dire le trajet que vous faites le plus souvent dans votre vie quotidienne, par exemple pour aller au travail, à l’université, à l’école, faire des courses ou participer à d’autres activités régulières. Elles portent à la fois sur la sécurité routière, c’est-à-dire la protection contre les accidents ou les blessures, et sur la sécurité personnelle, c’est-à-dire la protection contre la criminalité, le harcèlement ou les situations où vous ne vous sentez pas en sécurité.
fr.#How secure do you feel on your typical: Pendant votre trajet habituel, à quel point vous sentez-vous en sécurité par rapport au risque de criminalité ou de harcèlement ?
fr.#What factors most reduce your sense of: Quels facteurs réduisent le plus votre sentiment de sécurité personnelle ?
fr.#Poor lighting (e.g., dark streets, unde: Mauvais éclairage (par ex. rues sombres, passages souterrains)
fr.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: Peu ou pas de personnes autour (zones isolées ou désertes)
fr.#Presence of suspicious or aggressive in: Présence de personnes qui semblent menaçantes ou agressives
fr.#Overcrowding or chaotic environments: Trop de monde ou environnement désordonné
fr.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: Mauvaise visibilité (par ex. angles morts, vue bloquée)
fr.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: Mauvais entretien (par ex. bâtiments abandonnés, graffitis, infrastructures cassées)
fr.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: Manque de surveillance ou de mesures de sécurité (par ex. pas de caméra, pas de personnel)
fr.#Previous personal or reported incidents: Incidents déjà vécus ou signalés dans la zone
fr.#I don't feel insecure at all: Je ne me sens pas du tout en insécurité
fr.#How safe (e.g. accidents, road conditio: En ce qui concerne les accidents et l’état des routes, à quel point considérez-vous votre environnement de déplacement habituel comme sûr ?
fr.#Which of the following situations on a: Parmi les situations suivantes, lesquelles vous semblent dangereuses pendant un déplacement ?
fr.#Heavy or fast-moving traffic: Trafic dense ou véhicules roulant vite
fr.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Manque d’infrastructures sûres ou adaptées (par ex. trottoirs, traversées, pistes cyclables, éclairage)
fr.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Routes ou chemins en mauvais état (par ex. nids-de-poule, débris, surfaces irrégulières)
fr.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: Mauvaise visibilité ou champ de vision limité
fr.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Comportement dangereux de conducteurs, cyclistes, usagers de deux-roues ou piétons
fr.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: Forte affluence ou conflits avec d’autres usagers de la route
fr.#I don't feel unsafe at all: Je ne me sens jamais en danger
fr.#<p>Questions about how your surrounding: Questions sur la façon dont votre environnement influence votre expérience de déplacement.
fr.#Thinking about your typical journey, to: Pendant votre trajet habituel, dans quelle mesure le bruit de la circulation vous dérange-t-il ?
fr.#How do air quality and pollution levels: Comment la qualité de l’air et la pollution, par exemple les gaz d’échappement, la poussière ou les mauvaises odeurs, influencent-elles votre trajet ?
fr.#I notice it but it doesn't change my be: Je le remarque, mais cela ne change pas ma façon de me déplacer
fr.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. m: Cela me fait adapter ma façon de voyager, par exemple porter un masque ou fermer les fenêtres
fr.#It makes me change my route or travel a: Cela me fait changer d’itinéraire ou d’heure de déplacement
fr.#It makes me switch to a different mode: Cela me fait choisir un autre mode de transport
fr.#If the weather is poor (e.g., rain, win: Quand il fait mauvais, par exemple pluie, vent, froid, forte chaleur ou humidité, comment cela influence-t-il votre trajet habituel ?
fr.#It makes my journey less comfortable, b: Cela rend mon trajet moins confortable, mais je ne change pas ma façon de me déplacer
fr.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g.,: Cela me fait adapter ma façon de me déplacer, par exemple mes vêtements, ma préparation ou mon itinéraire
fr.#It makes me postpone or avoid some trip: Cela me fait reporter ou éviter certains déplacements quand c’est possible
fr.#It makes me switch to a different mode: Cela me fait choisir un autre mode de transport
fr.#How do the cleanliness and maintenance: Comment la propreté et l’entretien des chemins et des équipements, par exemple les déchets, les mauvaises odeurs ou le verre cassé, influencent-ils votre trajet ?
fr.#No effect on how I travel: Aucun effet sur ma façon de me déplacer
fr.#I notice it but carry on as usual: Je le remarque, mais je continue comme d’habitude
fr.#It makes the journey unpleasant but I s: Cela rend le trajet désagréable, mais je continue à utiliser cet itinéraire
fr.#It makes me avoid certain stops or sect: Cela me fait éviter certains arrêts ou certaines parties de l’itinéraire
fr.#It puts me off using this route entirel: Cela me décourage complètement d’utiliser cet itinéraire
fr.#How much does the visual quality of you: Dans quelle mesure l’aspect visuel de votre environnement, par exemple l’architecture, les espaces publics ou l’ambiance générale, influence-t-il votre expérience de déplacement ?
fr.#Not at all, I do not pay attention to t: Pas du tout : je ne fais pas attention à l’aspect visuel de mon environnement
fr.#Slightly, I notice the surroundings, bu: Un peu : je remarque mon environnement, mais il influence rarement mon expérience
fr.#Moderately, pleasant or unpleasant surr: Modérément : un environnement agréable ou désagréable influence parfois mon humeur pendant le trajet
fr.#Strongly, the visual environment signif: Beaucoup : l’aspect visuel de l’environnement influence fortement mon expérience de déplacement
fr.#Very strongly, I sometimes choose route: Énormément : il m’arrive de choisir certains itinéraires parce qu’ils sont beaux ou intéressants

de.#Welcome to Safety and Environment: Willkommen beim Fragebogen zu Sicherheit und Umwelt
de.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Dieser SmartUrbanity-Fragebogen befasst sich mit Ihrem Gefühl von Verkehrssicherheit und persönlicher Sicherheit sowie mit Umweltbedingungen während Ihrer Wege. Ihre Antworten helfen uns zu verstehen, welche Merkmale von Straßen und Stadtumgebung Komfort, Risiko und Zugänglichkeit beeinflussen. Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig und anonym.

Mehr über SmartUrbanity erfahren
de.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Ihre Antwort wurde gespeichert. Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich Zeit für diesen Fragebogen genommen haben.
de.#<p>Questions about how safe and secure: Die folgenden Fragen beziehen sich darauf, wie sicher Sie sich auf Ihrem typischen Weg fühlen. Gemeint ist der Weg, den Sie im Alltag am häufigsten machen, zum Beispiel zur Arbeit, Universität, Schule, zum Einkaufen oder zu anderen regelmäßigen Aktivitäten. Es geht sowohl um Verkehrssicherheit, also Schutz vor Unfällen oder Verletzungen, als auch um persönliche Sicherheit, also Schutz vor Kriminalität, Belästigung oder Situationen, in denen Sie sich unsicher fühlen.
de.#How secure do you feel on your typical: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich auf Ihrem typischen Weg im Hinblick auf Kriminalität oder Belästigung?
de.#What factors most reduce your sense of: Welche Faktoren verringern Ihr Gefühl persönlicher Sicherheit am stärksten?
de.#Poor lighting (e.g., dark streets, unde: Schlechte Beleuchtung (z. B. dunkle Straßen, Unterführungen)
de.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: Wenig oder keine Menschen in der Umgebung (einsame oder verlassene Bereiche)
de.#Presence of suspicious or aggressive in: Anwesenheit von Personen, die bedrohlich oder aggressiv wirken
de.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: Schlechte Sicht (z. B. unübersichtliche Ecken, versperrte Sicht)
de.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: Schlechte Instandhaltung (z. B. verlassene Gebäude, Graffiti, beschädigte Infrastruktur)
de.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: Fehlende Überwachung oder Sicherheitsmaßnahmen (z. B. keine Kameras, kein Personal)
de.#Previous personal or reported incidents: Frühere eigene Erlebnisse oder gemeldete Vorfälle in diesem Bereich
de.#I don't feel insecure at all: Ich fühle mich überhaupt nicht unsicher
de.#How safe (e.g. accidents, road conditio: Wie sicher ist Ihrer Meinung nach Ihre typische Verkehrsumgebung in Bezug auf Unfälle und Straßenbedingungen?
de.#Which of the following situations on a: Welche der folgenden Situationen empfinden Sie während eines Weges als unsicher?
de.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Fehlende sichere oder geeignete Infrastruktur (z. B. Gehwege, Querungen, Radwege, Beleuchtung)
de.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Schlechter Zustand von Straßen oder Wegen (z. B. Schlaglöcher, Schmutz, unebene Flächen)
de.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Gefährliches Verhalten von Autofahrern, Zweiradfahrern oder Fußgängern
de.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: Überfüllung oder Konflikte mit anderen Verkehrsteilnehmenden
de.#I don't feel unsafe at all: Ich fühle mich überhaupt nicht gefährdet
de.#<p>Questions about how your surrounding: Fragen dazu, wie Ihre Umgebung Ihr Erlebnis unterwegs beeinflusst.
de.#Thinking about your typical journey, to: Wenn Sie an Ihren typischen Weg denken: Wie sehr stört Sie Verkehrslärm?
de.#How do air quality and pollution levels: Wie beeinflussen Luftqualität und Verschmutzung, zum Beispiel Abgase, Staub oder unangenehme Gerüche, Ihren Weg?
de.#I notice it but it doesn't change my be: Ich bemerke es, aber es verändert mein Verhalten nicht
de.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. m: Ich passe an, wie ich unterwegs bin, zum Beispiel mit Maske oder geschlossenen Fenstern
de.#It makes me change my route or travel a: Ich ändere meine Route oder fahre zu einer anderen Zeit
de.#It makes me switch to a different mode: Ich wechsle ganz zu einem anderen Verkehrsmittel
de.#If the weather is poor (e.g., rain, win: Wenn das Wetter schlecht ist, zum Beispiel Regen, Wind, Kälte, starke Hitze oder hohe Luftfeuchtigkeit: Wie beeinflusst das Ihren typischen Weg?
de.#It makes my journey less comfortable, b: Es macht meinen Weg weniger angenehm, aber ich ändere nicht, wie ich unterwegs bin
de.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g.,: Ich passe meine Art zu reisen an, zum Beispiel Kleidung, Vorbereitung oder Route
de.#It makes me postpone or avoid some trip: Ich verschiebe oder vermeide manche Wege, wenn es möglich ist
de.#It makes me switch to a different mode: Ich wechsle zu einem anderen Verkehrsmittel
de.#How do the cleanliness and maintenance: Wie beeinflussen Sauberkeit und Zustand von Wegen und Einrichtungen, zum Beispiel Müll, Gerüche oder Glasscherben, Ihren Weg?
de.#No effect on how I travel: Kein Einfluss darauf, wie ich unterwegs bin
de.#I notice it but carry on as usual: Ich bemerke es, mache aber wie gewohnt weiter

tr.#Welcome to Safety and Environment: Güvenlik ve Çevre Anketine Hoş Geldiniz
tr.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Bu SmartUrbanity anketi yolculuklarınız sırasında trafik güvenliği, kişisel güvenlik ve çevre koşullarını nasıl algıladığınızla ilgilidir. Yanıtlarınız, sokakların ve kentsel çevrenin hangi özelliklerinin konforu, riski ve erişilebilirliği etkilediğini anlamamıza yardımcı olur. Katılım gönüllü ve anonimdir.

SmartUrbanity hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinin
tr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Yanıtınız kaydedildi. Bu anketi doldurmak için zaman ayırdığınız için teşekkür ederiz.
tr.#<p>Questions about how safe and secure: Aşağıdaki sorular tipik yolculuğunuz sırasında kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissettiğinizle ilgilidir. Tipik yolculuk, günlük yaşamda en sık yaptığınız yolculuktur; örneğin işe, üniversiteye, okula, alışverişe veya başka düzenli etkinliklere giderken. Sorular hem trafik güvenliğini, yani kaza veya fiziksel yaralanmalardan korunmayı, hem de kişisel güvenliği, yani suç, taciz veya güvensiz hissettiren durumlardan korunmayı kapsar.
tr.#How secure do you feel on your typical: Tipik yolculuğunuz sırasında suç veya taciz açısından kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#What factors most reduce your sense of: Kişisel güvenlik hissinizi en çok hangi faktörler azaltıyor?
tr.#Poor lighting (e.g., dark streets, unde: Yetersiz aydınlatma (ör. karanlık sokaklar, alt geçitler)
tr.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: Çevrede insanların olmaması (ıssız veya tenha alanlar)
tr.#Presence of suspicious or aggressive in: Tehditkâr veya saldırgan görünen kişilerin bulunması
tr.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: Kötü görüş (ör. kör noktalar, kapanmış görüş alanı)
tr.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: Kötü bakım (ör. terk edilmiş binalar, grafiti, hasarlı altyapı)
tr.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: Gözetim veya güvenlik önlemlerinin olmaması (ör. kamera veya görevli olmaması)
tr.#Previous personal or reported incidents: Bölgede daha önce yaşanmış veya bildirilmiş olaylar
tr.#How safe (e.g. accidents, road conditio: Kazalar ve yol koşulları açısından tipik yolculuk çevrenizi ne kadar güvenli buluyorsunuz?
tr.#Which of the following situations on a: Aşağıdaki durumlardan hangilerini yolculuk sırasında tehlikeli buluyorsunuz?
tr.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Güvenli veya yeterli altyapının olmaması (ör. kaldırımlar, geçişler, bisiklet yolları, aydınlatma)
tr.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Yol veya patikaların kötü durumda olması (ör. çukurlar, moloz, düzensiz yüzeyler)
tr.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: Kötü görüş veya sınırlı görüş mesafesi
tr.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Sürücülerin, iki tekerlekli araç kullanıcılarının veya yayaların tehlikeli davranışları
tr.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: Kalabalık veya diğer yol kullanıcılarıyla çatışma
tr.#<p>Questions about how your surrounding: Çevrenizin yolculuk deneyiminizi nasıl etkilediği hakkında sorular.
tr.#Thinking about your typical journey, to: Tipik yolculuğunuzu düşündüğünüzde trafik gürültüsü sizi ne kadar rahatsız ediyor?
tr.#How do air quality and pollution levels: Hava kalitesi ve kirlilik, örneğin egzoz dumanı, toz veya kötü kokular, yolculuğunuzu nasıl etkiliyor?
tr.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. m: Nasıl seyahat ettiğimi değiştirmeme neden olur; örneğin maske kullanır veya camları kapatırım
tr.#It makes me change my route or travel a: Güzergâhımı değiştirmeme veya farklı bir saatte seyahat etmeme neden olur
tr.#It makes me switch to a different mode: Tamamen farklı bir ulaşım seçeneğine geçmeme neden olur
tr.#If the weather is poor (e.g., rain, win: Hava kötü olduğunda, örneğin yağmur, rüzgâr, soğuk, aşırı sıcak veya nem varsa, tipik yolculuğunuz nasıl etkilenir?
tr.#It makes my journey less comfortable, b: Yolculuğumu daha az konforlu yapar ama nasıl seyahat ettiğimi değiştirmem
tr.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g.,: Nasıl seyahat ettiğimi değiştiririm; örneğin kıyafetimi, hazırlığımı veya güzergâhımı değiştiririm
tr.#It makes me postpone or avoid some trip: Mümkün olduğunda bazı yolculukları erteler veya yapmam
tr.#How do the cleanliness and maintenance: Yolların ve tesislerin temizliği ve bakımı, örneğin çöp, kötü koku veya kırık cam, yolculuğunuzu nasıl etkiler?
tr.#I notice it but carry on as usual: Fark ederim ama her zamanki gibi devam ederim
tr.#It makes the journey unpleasant but I s: Yolculuğu rahatsız edici hale getirir ama yine de aynı güzergâhı kullanırım
tr.#It makes me avoid certain stops or sect: Bazı duraklardan veya güzergâh bölümlerinden kaçınmama neden olur
tr.#It puts me off using this route entirel: Bu güzergâhı tamamen kullanmamama neden olur
tr.#How much does the visual quality of you: Çevrenizin görsel kalitesi, örneğin mimari, kamusal alanlar veya genel atmosfer, yolculuk deneyiminizi ne kadar etkiler?
tr.#Not at all, I do not pay attention to t: Hiç etkilemez — çevrenin görünümüne dikkat etmem
tr.#Slightly, I notice the surroundings, bu: Biraz etkiler — çevreyi fark ederim ama deneyimimi nadiren etkiler
tr.#Moderately, pleasant or unpleasant surr: Orta düzeyde etkiler — hoş veya hoş olmayan çevre bazen yolculuk sırasındaki ruh halimi etkiler
tr.#Strongly, the visual environment signif: Çok etkiler — çevrenin görünümü yolculuk deneyimimi belirgin şekilde etkiler
tr.#Very strongly, I sometimes choose route: Çok güçlü etkiler — bazen güzergâhları daha güzel veya ilgi çekici oldukları için seçerim

fa.#Welcome to Safety and Environment: به پرسشنامه ایمنی و محیط خوش آمدید
fa.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
این پرسشنامه SmartUrbanity درباره برداشت شما از ایمنی ترافیکی، امنیت شخصی و شرایط محیطی در طول سفرهاست. پاسخ‌های شما کمک می‌کند بفهمیم کدام ویژگی‌های خیابان و محیط شهری بر راحتی، خطر و دسترس‌پذیری اثر می‌گذارند. شرکت در این پرسشنامه داوطلبانه و ناشناس است.

درباره SmartUrbanity بیشتر بدانید
fa.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: پاسخ شما ثبت شد. از وقتی که برای تکمیل این پرسشنامه گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#<p>Questions about how safe and secure: سؤال‌های زیر درباره میزان احساس امنیت شما در سفر معمول است؛ یعنی سفری که در زندگی روزمره بیشتر انجام می‌دهید، مثلاً برای کار، دانشگاه، مدرسه، خرید یا فعالیت‌های منظم دیگر. منظور هم ایمنی ترافیکی است، یعنی محافظت در برابر تصادف یا آسیب جسمی، و هم امنیت شخصی، یعنی محافظت در برابر جرم، آزار یا موقعیت‌هایی که در آن احساس ناامنی می‌کنید.
fa.#How secure do you feel on your typical: در سفر معمول خود از نظر خطر جرم یا آزار چقدر احساس امنیت می‌کنید؟

fa.#What factors most reduce your sense of: کدام عامل‌ها بیشترین کاهش را در احساس امنیت شخصی شما ایجاد می‌کنند؟

fa.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: دید ضعیف (مثلاً گوشه کور، دید بسته)

fa.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: نبود نظارت یا اقدامات امنیتی (مثلاً نبود دوربین یا کارکنان)
fa.#Previous personal or reported incidents: اتفاق‌های قبلی که خودم تجربه کرده‌ام یا در آن منطقه گزارش شده‌اند
fa.#How safe (e.g. accidents, road conditio: از نظر تصادف و وضعیت راه، محیط معمول سفر خود را چقدر ایمن می‌دانید؟

fa.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: وضعیت نامناسب خیابان یا مسیر (مثلاً چاله، زباله، سطح ناهموار)

fa.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: شلوغی یا برخورد و تعارض با سایر کاربران راه
fa.#<p>Questions about how your surrounding: سؤال‌هایی درباره اینکه محیط اطراف چگونه بر تجربه سفر شما اثر می‌گذارد.
fa.#Thinking about your typical journey, to: وقتی به سفر معمول خود فکر می‌کنید، صدای ترافیک چقدر شما را آزار می‌دهد؟
fa.#How do air quality and pollution levels: کیفیت هوا و آلودگی، مانند دود اگزوز، گردوغبار یا بوی نامطبوع، چگونه بر سفر شما اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#I notice it but it doesn't change my be: متوجه می‌شوم، اما رفتارم را تغییر نمی‌دهد

fa.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g.,: باعث می‌شود نحوه سفرم را تغییر دهم، مثلاً لباس، آمادگی یا مسیر را عوض کنم
fa.#It makes me postpone or avoid some trip: اگر ممکن باشد بعضی سفرها را عقب می‌اندازم یا انجام نمی‌دهم
fa.#It makes me switch to a different mode: به روش دیگری برای رفت‌وآمد تغییر می‌دهم
fa.#How do the cleanliness and maintenance: پاکیزگی و نگهداری مسیرها و امکانات، مانند زباله، بو یا شیشه شکسته، چگونه بر سفر شما اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#No effect on how I travel: بر روش سفر من اثری ندارد
fa.#I notice it but carry on as usual: متوجه می‌شوم، اما طبق معمول ادامه می‌دهم
fa.#It makes the journey unpleasant but I s: سفر را ناخوشایند می‌کند، اما همچنان از همان مسیر استفاده می‌کنم
fa.#It makes me avoid certain stops or sect: باعث می‌شود از بعضی ایستگاه‌ها یا بخش‌های مسیر دوری کنم
fa.#It puts me off using this route entirel: باعث می‌شود دیگر اصلاً از آن مسیر استفاده نکنم
fa.#How much does the visual quality of you: کیفیت ظاهری محیط اطراف، مانند معماری، فضاهای عمومی یا حال‌وهوای کلی، تا چه اندازه بر تجربه سفر شما اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#Not at all, I do not pay attention to t: اصلاً؛ به ظاهر محیط توجه نمی‌کنم
fa.#Slightly, I notice the surroundings, bu: کمی؛ محیط را می‌بینم، اما به ندرت بر تجربه من اثر می‌گذارد
fa.#Moderately, pleasant or unpleasant surr: تا حد متوسط؛ محیط خوشایند یا ناخوشایند گاهی بر حال من در سفر اثر می‌گذارد
fa.#Strongly, the visual environment signif: زیاد؛ ظاهر محیط به‌طور قابل توجهی بر تجربه سفر من اثر دارد
fa.#Very strongly, I sometimes choose route: خیلی زیاد؛ گاهی مسیرها را به دلیل زیبا یا جالب بودن انتخاب می‌کنم

hu.#Welcome to Safety and Environment: Üdvözöljük a biztonságról és környezetről szóló kérdőívben
hu.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Ez a SmartUrbanity kérdőív arról szól, hogyan érzékeli a közlekedésbiztonságot, a személyes biztonságot és a környezeti körülményeket utazás közben. Válaszai segítenek megérteni, hogy az utcák és a városi környezet mely jellemzői befolyásolják a kényelmet, a kockázatot és a hozzáférhetőséget. A részvétel önkéntes és anonim.

További információ a SmartUrbanity projektről
hu.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Válaszát rögzítettük. Köszönjük, hogy időt szánt a kérdőív kitöltésére.
hu.#<p>Questions about how safe and secure: A következő kérdések arra vonatkoznak, mennyire érzi magát biztonságban a tipikus utazása során. Ez az az út, amelyet a mindennapi életben a leggyakrabban tesz meg, például munkába, egyetemre, iskolába, vásárolni vagy más rendszeres tevékenységhez. A kérdések egyaránt vonatkoznak a közlekedésbiztonságra, vagyis a balesetek és sérülések elleni védelemre, valamint a személyes biztonságra, vagyis a bűncselekmények, zaklatás és a bizonytalanságot okozó helyzetek elleni védelemre.
hu.#How secure do you feel on your typical: Mennyire érzi magát biztonságban a tipikus utazása során bűncselekmény vagy zaklatás szempontjából?
hu.#What factors most reduce your sense of: Mely tényezők csökkentik leginkább a személyes biztonságérzetét?
hu.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: Kevés vagy egyáltalán nincs ember a közelben (elszigetelt vagy kihalt területek)
hu.#Presence of suspicious or aggressive in: Fenyegetőnek vagy agresszívnak tűnő emberek jelenléte
hu.#Overcrowding or chaotic environments: Túl nagy tömeg vagy kaotikus környezet
hu.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: Rossz beláthatóság (pl. beláthatatlan sarkok, akadályozott kilátás)
hu.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: Rossz karbantartás (pl. elhagyott épületek, graffiti, sérült infrastruktúra)
hu.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: Megfigyelés vagy biztonsági intézkedések hiánya (pl. nincs kamera, nincs személyzet)
hu.#Previous personal or reported incidents: Korábbi személyes vagy bejelentett esetek a környéken
hu.#How safe (e.g. accidents, road conditio: Balesetek és útviszonyok szempontjából mennyire tartja biztonságosnak a tipikus közlekedési környezetét?
hu.#Which of the following situations on a: Az alábbi helyzetek közül melyeket tartja veszélyesnek utazás közben?
hu.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Biztonságos vagy megfelelő infrastruktúra hiánya (pl. járdák, átkelőhelyek, kerékpárutak, világítás)
hu.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Rossz út- vagy járdaviszonyok (pl. kátyúk, törmelék, egyenetlen felületek)
hu.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: Rossz látási viszonyok vagy korlátozott beláthatóság
hu.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Járművezetők, kétkerekű járművek használói vagy gyalogosok veszélyes viselkedése
hu.#<p>Questions about how your surrounding: Kérdések arról, hogyan befolyásolja a környezete az utazási élményét.
hu.#Thinking about your typical journey, to: Ha a tipikus utazására gondol, mennyire zavarja a közlekedési zaj?
hu.#How do air quality and pollution levels: Hogyan befolyásolja a levegő minősége és a szennyezés, például a kipufogógáz, por vagy kellemetlen szag az utazását?
hu.#I notice it but it doesn't change my be: Észreveszem, de nem változtatja meg a viselkedésemet
hu.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. m: Módosítom, hogyan utazom, például maszkot használok vagy felhúzom az ablakot
hu.#It makes me change my route or travel a: Megváltoztatom az útvonalat vagy más időpontban utazom
hu.#If the weather is poor (e.g., rain, win: Ha rossz az idő, például eső, szél, hideg, nagy hőség vagy magas páratartalom van, hogyan befolyásolja ez a tipikus utazását?
hu.#It makes my journey less comfortable, b: Kényelmetlenebbé teszi az utat, de nem változtatom meg, hogyan közlekedem
hu.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g.,: Módosítom a közlekedésemet, például az öltözetet, a felkészülést vagy az útvonalat
hu.#It makes me postpone or avoid some trip: Ha lehet, elhalasztok vagy elkerülök bizonyos utakat
hu.#How do the cleanliness and maintenance: Hogyan befolyásolja az utak és létesítmények tisztasága és karbantartása, például a szemét, szagok vagy törött üveg az utazását?
hu.#I notice it but carry on as usual: Észreveszem, de a megszokott módon folytatom
hu.#It makes the journey unpleasant but I s: Kellemetlenné teszi az utat, de továbbra is használom az útvonalat
hu.#How much does the visual quality of you: Mennyire befolyásolja a környezet látványa, például az építészet, a közterek vagy az általános hangulat az utazási élményét?
hu.#Not at all, I do not pay attention to t: Egyáltalán nem — nem figyelek a környezet látványára
hu.#Slightly, I notice the surroundings, bu: Kissé — észreveszem a környezetet, de ritkán befolyásolja az élményemet
hu.#Moderately, pleasant or unpleasant surr: Közepesen — a kellemes vagy kellemetlen környezet néha befolyásolja a hangulatomat utazás közben
hu.#Strongly, the visual environment signif: Erősen — a környezet látványa jelentősen befolyásolja az utazási élményemet
hu.#Very strongly, I sometimes choose route: Nagyon erősen — néha azért választok útvonalat, mert szép vagy érdekes
